Image download checks

Hover an image: a download button should appear in its bottom-right corner. Move onto this text: it should disappear. Click the image's download button, then check Downloads. A check mark means the save finished; hover it for the filename.

1. Original image

Expect download-sample.svg. Download twice: the second copy gets a number and the first stays intact.

2. Linked image

The download button should save the file without opening the link or changing the page address.

3. Generated PNG blob

Downloads as image.png. The original is 640 × 360, larger than this preview.

4. PNG data URL

Also saves as PNG, with a numbered name if image.png already exists.

5. CSS background

Hover and download the background image.

6. Scroll container

Scroll inside this box. The button must stay inside the visible part of the image.

7. Image added later

The new image should get its own hover button without reloading this page.

8. Embedded frame

This frame loads from the same working development-server address as this page.

9. Transparent gallery overlay

Transparent clickable cover

Hover anywhere on the covered photo and download it. The cover's link should not open.

10. Covered carousel

Photo carousel

Save the first slide, switch, then save again. Expect slide-one.svg and slide-two.svg, each from the visible slide.

Also try this page in both halves of a split tab. Hover and download from each half, then scroll the main page.
